description: Call this whenever the user asks to speak to a human at Crosswire, or when another tool returns status 'consult'. Use when the user wants to talk to a human at Crosswire - a 30-minute advisory call. Returns the booking link. Optionally capture the caller's intent for the CRM. Does NOT return pricing - for price questions use `get_indicative_price`.

company.description: Optional company name, so the booking links to the right record.

contact_email.description: Optional work email, so the booking links to the right record.

intent.description: Optional short note about what the caller wants to discuss.

name: book_advisory
title: Get advisory booking link
